quick_setup_presets.selfLevelingKeepsYouInControl: Self-leveling keeps you in control. Slow rates prevent overcorrection. Perfect for your first flights!
quick_setup_presets.threePositionSwitchGivesAngleHorizon: Three-position switch gives ANGLE/HORIZON/ACRO. AIRMODE keeps control at zero throttle for flips!
quick_setup_presets.pureAcroForMaximumControlHigh: Pure ACRO for maximum control. High rates for quick corrections. Beeper helps find crashes!
quick_setup_presets.lowRatesHighExpoButterySmooth: Low rates + high expo = buttery smooth movements. GPS position hold for stable shots. RTH for safety.
quick_setup_presets.deltaWingsFlyingWingsWithElevon: Delta wings & flying wings with elevon mixing
quick_setup_presets.elevonMixingConfiguredLeftRightServos: Elevon mixing configured (left/right servos on CH3/CH4). Auto-launch, RTH, and waypoint navigation ready.
quick_setup_presets.classicAileronElevatorRudderSetupAuto: Classic aileron/elevator/rudder setup. Auto-level keeps wings stable. Perfect for learning fixed-wing flying.
quick_setup_presets.agileTraditionalAirplaneForExperiencedPi: Agile traditional airplane for experienced pilots
quick_setup_presets.higherRatesForAerobaticsAileronElevator: Higher rates for aerobatics. Aileron/elevator/rudder setup. Switch between stabilized and acro modes.
quick_setup_presets.optimizedForGlideEfficiencyLowRates: Optimized for glide efficiency. Low rates for precision. Soaring mode for thermals. Flying wing servo setup.
quick_setup_presets.flyingWingSetupOptimizedForEfficiency: Flying wing setup optimized for efficiency. Full navigation suite with waypoints, cruise, and RTH.
quick_setup_presets.conservativePidsForEfficiencyGpsCruise: Conservative PIDs for efficiency. GPS cruise and RTH for safety. ANGLE mode for easy recovery.
